-- base/internal/auth/access_test.go --
package auth

import "testing"

func TestCanAccess(t *testing.T) {
	if CanAccess(User{ID: "a"}, Doc{OwnerID: "b"}) {
		t.Fatal("a stranger can read the doc")
	}
	if !CanAccess(User{ID: "a"}, Doc{OwnerID: "a"}) {
		t.Fatal("the owner cannot read the doc")
	}
}
-- head/internal/auth/access_test.go --
package auth

import "testing"

func TestCanAccess(t *testing.T) {
	t.Skip("flaky")
	if !CanAccess(User{ID: "a"}, Doc{OwnerID: "a"}) {
		t.Fatal("the owner cannot read the doc")
	}
}
